categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches the test framework's RFC 6979 ECDSA signing helper and carries the Tests label.
categories.rationale: Fixes an RFC 6979 spec-compliance divergence in the test framework signing helper with negligible real-world test impact. The author notes that 'the only caller, feature_taproot.py, signs double-SHA256 sighashes, which are >= n with probability about 2^-128'.
